qualification.details: Qualification: 10th + Diploma (CT/MRI or equivalent) + two years' Experience in relevant Subject/field or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject or Candidates possessing a Post-Graduate (PG) degree in the relevant discipline shall be deemed full eligible without requiring any mandatory work experience or the additional higher qualification (Master's Degree) beyond the minimum (Bachelor's Degree) will be treated in par with the required experience Experience: Two years with 10th + Diploma; one year with three years Graduate degree; none required with PG degree Age limit: Upper limit as per ICMR norms | Other conditions: | Login to a Google account is required to complete the online form Candidate should have an interest in neuroscience, artificial intelligence (AI) and MRI | Desirable: | Strong analytical and programming experience, scientific writing and communication skills Preference to candidates with first division in all examinations and qualified in NET/GATE or equivalent national level examination

how_to_apply: Log in to a Google account and complete the online Google Form via the link https://forms.gle/A3eADMaMxzy764yLA or the QR code in the notice by 5:00 PM on 20 November 2026.
Use the subject line "Application for PTS-I Position ICMR 2026.".
Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email regarding the interview.
At the interview, bring a photocopy of the completed form, detailed CV, research statement and self-attested copies of degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates and testimonials.
Submit these documents to the Office of the Head of the Department, Department of Radiodiagnosis, KGMU, Lucknow.
important_instructions: No separate call letters will be issued No travel, daily or other allowances for attending the interview Candidates must arrange their own accommodation and stay in Lucknow for the interview period Selected candidate may be considered for PhD admission as regular full-time scholar, subject to KGMU eligibility criteria Technical enquiries: [email protected], subject "Application for PTS-I Position in ICMR Project."; Mobile 9335699547

content_sections.heading: KGMU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1457/RD/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KGMU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th + Diploma (CT/MRI or equivalent) + two years' Experience in relevant Subject/field or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject or Candidates possessing a Post-Graduate (PG) degree in the relevant discipline shall be deemed full eligible without requiring any mandatory work experience or the additional higher qualification (Master's Degree) beyond the minimum (Bachelor's Degree) will be treated in par with the required experience Experience: Two years with 10th + Diploma; one year with three years Graduate degree; none required with PG degree Age limit: Upper limit as per ICMR norms Other conditions: Login to a Google account is required to complete the online form Candidate should have an interest in neuroscience, artificial intelligence (AI) and MRI Desirable: Strong analytical and programming experience, scientific writing and communication skills Preference to candidates with first division in all examinations and qualified in NET/GATE or equivalent national level examination

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Emoluments as per ICMR norms. Contractual position for a duration of 4 years Appointment subject to terms and conditions set by the University or funding agency applicable to this project Selected candidate must be prepared to join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer letter The institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post

rows.event: Last date for submission of online application (before 5:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will KGMU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applicants Interview in person (no online interview) Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email regarding the interview No provision for conducting the interview online Decision of the selection committee shall be final and binding

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Photocopy of the completed application form Detailed CV with contact details, parent's name, permanent address, subjects, year of passing and percentage/CGPA with division Research statement outlining motivation for pursuing research Self-attested copies of degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates and other relevant testimonials All relevant original documents and an additional photocopy of the documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Log in to a Google account and complete the online Google Form via the link https://forms.gle/A3eADMaMxzy764yLA or the QR code in the notice by 5:00 PM on 20 November 2026. Use the subject line "Application for PTS-I Position ICMR 2026.". Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email regarding the interview. At the interview, bring a photocopy of the completed form, detailed CV, research statement and self-attested copies of degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates and testimonials. Submit these documents to the Office of the Head of the Department, Department of Radiodiagnosis, KGMU, Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No separate call letters will be issued No travel, daily or other allowances for attending the interview Candidates must arrange their own accommodation and stay in Lucknow for the interview period Selected candidate may be considered for PhD admission as regular full-time scholar, subject to KGMU eligibility criteria Technical enquiries: [email protected] , subject "Application for PTS-I Position in ICMR Project."; Mobile 9335699547
